scope: Source-level guard for packets to peers without established data channels; actual fixed-Wasm TURN recovery still pending
cause: Recovery Hello was queued before the replacement peer data channel existed. Matchbox try_send accepted the queue item, then its asynchronous message loop panicked at the missing peer channel expectation.
correction: WebRtcTransport refuses reliable and snapshot sends until the destination appears in connected_peers. Normal established peer sends remain supported.

regression.red_failure: Reliable send incorrectly returned success for a real new transport with zero connected peers
